response:
I hear what you're saying, and I definitely recognize that social media has real upsides—like helping people stay connected across distances or giving marginalized groups a platform. It makes sense that a lot of people value those things.

At the same time, just because a view is popular doesn't automatically make it right. When I look at the broader patterns—like the rise in teen anxiety, how algorithms reward outrage over nuance, and how hard it's become for people to just focus—I still think the net effect leans negative. I'm open to new evidence, of course, but I'd need more than consensus to change my mind on this one.
